mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${tableName} ( id BIGINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, lock_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, locked_by VARCHAR(128), locked_until TIMESTAMP(3), gmt_create TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, gmt_modified TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uk_${tableName}_lock_name UNIQUE (lock_name) )
UPDATE ${tableName} SET locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL WHERE lock_name = #{lockName} AND locked_by = #{ownerId}
